mapping.author: claude-mapper-m6
mapping.draft_py:
# Needletooth Pack (FDN), a 4/5 Dinosaur for {3}{G}{G}.
# "Morbid — At the beginning of your end step, if a creature died this turn, put two +1/+1
#  counters on target creature you control."
# Trigger: M21 Twinblade Assassins' verified B2a-twinblade-assassins, the same sentence up to the
#   effect: END_TURN of your turn, the intervening "if" DIED_THIS_TURN as the condition. Morbid
#   is an ability word (CR 207.2c).
# Effect: B5b-put-counter's "Put a +1/+1 counter on target creature you control." (M21 Feat of
#   Resistance, verified) with the printed count 2.
end_step = TriggeredAbility(
    event=TurnPhaseEvent(
        phase=Phase.END_TURN,
        actor=FAtom(pred=FAtomPred.CONTROLLER_IS, who=ControllerRef.YOU),
    ),
    condition=FAtom(pred=FAtomPred.DIED_THIS_TURN),
    effect=A(Verb.PUT_COUNTER, {
        'count': QConst(value=2),
        'counter_kind': CounterKind.PLUS_1_PLUS_1,
        'target': Selector(
            count=QConst(value=1),
            mode=SelectorMode.TARGET,
            filter=FAnd(
                children=(
                    FAtom(pred=FAtomPred.CONTROLLER_IS, who=ControllerRef.YOU),
                    FAtom(pred=FAtomPred.TYPE_EQ, string_value='Creature'),
                ),
            ),
            zones=(Zone(kind=ZoneKind.BATTLEFIELD, controller=ControllerRef.ANY),),
        ),
    }),
)
abilities = [end_step, *compiled]

clauses.clause: Morbid — At the beginning of your end step, if a creature died this turn, put two +1/+1 counters on target creature you control.

mapping.notes: M21 Twinblade Assassins' morbid end-step trigger (verified) with M21 Feat of Resistance's counter on target creature you control, count 2. Packs: tools/scenarios/mapped/FDN/needletooth_pack_morbid_two_counters_on_the_target.json, tools/scenarios/mapped/FDN/needletooth_pack_no_counters_without_a_death_or_on_opponents_turn.json.
